implementation: One async semaphore serializes Append read/modify/write and Clear per store instance; finally releases after cancellation/failure. GetRecent remains observational. Existing newest-first/default250 retention and canonical command behavior retained.
limitations: Same scoped instance only; no cross-tab atomicity or coordination of independent scopes.
Synthetic gated storage and application regressions; no actual IndexedDB cancellation or physical device assertion. A storage cancellation cannot prove whether a JS transaction already committed.
No deployment, commit, live account or command mutation. Active controller time not instrumented.
